Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.wg

Interface LayoutManager3D

All Known Implementing Classes:
BookshelfLayout, HallwayLayout, HorizontalLayout, HorizontalLayout, HorizontalReorderableLayout, OrbitLayout, ThumbnailLayout, VerticalLayout, ZLayeredLayout, ZLayeredLayout, ZLayeredMovableLayout
public interface LayoutManager3D
Defines the interface for classes that know how to lay out Container3Ds. All the method invocations are synchronized by the associated Container3D.

      void setContainer(Container3D cont)
      Set the target container. Invoked with a valid target Container3D object when this layout is set to the container, and with null when the layout is removed from the container.

      parent - the container to be laid out

      boolean rearrangeLayoutComponent(Component3D comp, Object newConstraints)
